chapter: Tatum, Wiggins and Los Angeles friends
title: Let Freedom Swing and Talbert's NAACP events
summary: Willard recalls civil rights benefit concerts in the Sixties and Callender cannot recall whether he took part.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: Mine, too. But he sure put on some great musical events there. But we did some later, too, for the Beverly Hills-Hollywood NAACP that Jimmy was President of. We had a series of musical programs that I think Eddie Beal was the musical director on. And I named Let Freedom Swing, civil rights fundraisers in Hollywood -- but that was in the Sixties. But Jimmy was the spark behind that, too.
You were on some of them, I'm sure.
I don't know whether I was involved in it or not. In the Sixties.
I don't know whether I was involved in any of those or not, but...
It seems as though if Eddie Beal and Jimmy Talbert had something to do with it, I would have been there. Because our lives have seemed to criss-cross most of my life, really.
